objects.name: CISA Adds Exploited Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Auth Bypass to KEV
objects.description: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added a critical authentication bypass flaw impacting Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), following reports of active exploitation.
